name: Swensen's Ice Cream
source: restaurant website menu page + restaurant online-ordering page (Clover plugin on own site)

items.item: Toppings (jimmies, hot fudge, hot caramel, almonds)
Sundae (hot fudge, hot caramel, strawberry or chocolate)
Milkshake, Malt or Root Beer Float

items.description: e.g. black raspberry marble, bordeaux cherry, sticky chewy chocolate, swiss orange chip, turkish coffee, toasted almond, lychee, peppermint stick; seasonal pumpkin, eggnog, rum raisin

notes: Original 1948 Swensen's parlor; ice cream made in-house. Hours on site: Tue-Sun 12-10pm, closed Mon. Cup/scoop, pint/quart and extras prices come from the shop's own Clover pickup ordering; sundaes, milkshakes/malts/floats and sodas are listed on the menu page without prices. Flavor list abbreviated; merchandise omitted.
price_level_basis: median $3.55 of 6 prices in sections ['Cups & Cones']; rule L1<10, L2<18, L3<30, L4>=30
